caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jug with two handles, one on each side of the neck. The jug is tan or light brown in color overall, with darker brown patterns and accents. The patterns include leaf- and floral-like motifs along the body and neck of the jug, as well as small dot and diamond shapes. The neck of the jug is slightly flared, and the top opening reveals a hint of a glossy, grayish-blue interior. The jug stands alone against a plain, light background with no additional objects included in the composition. The artist's signature and date, "Chas F. Hoss 1912," appear in the lower right corner.
title: Vase
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
